records.jp: な、何その格好！？　怖いんだけど！？
records.en_original: Wh-what are you wearing?! You're scaring me!
records.en: Wh-what's with those outfits?! They're kind of scary!

records.jp: アソビタイ
あそびたい……って、は？
アソビタイ
アソビタイ
ちょっとマジでなんなの！？
三人……アソビタイ……水着……
records.en: Three of them... "want to play"... swimsuits...

records.jp: ハッ！　まさかこの三人は……
やめてお願い靭さん。<CR>あなたまでそっち側に行かないで
records.en_original: Stop, Utsubo. Don't let yourself become one of them.
records.en: Please stop, Utsubo-san.<CR>Don't you go over to their side too.

records.jp: 遊びたさが限界に達し、無理矢理にでも<CR>皆と遊んでやるぞと決心した時に現れる――
records.en_original: The group that only appears when our play levels have reached critical levels?!
records.en: They appear when their desire to play reaches its limit<CR>and they resolve to make everyone play with them by force—

records.jp: アソビタイ三銃士！！
アソビタイ！！
あ～あ、置いてかれた。<CR>また私が一人だ。一人だけまともなんだ
records.en_original: It seems I'm the only sane one left. All alone. It's better this way.
records.en: Aww, they left me behind.<CR>I'm alone again. The only sane one here.

records.jp: こんなところで会えるなんて感激なのです！<CR>今日は一体どうしたんですか？
records.en_original: It's an honor to meet you all! What's the problem today?
records.en: I can't believe I get to meet you here!<CR>What brings you here today?

records.jp: アソビタイ！
アソビタイ！
わたしと、伶那ちゃんと遊びたい……ってこと？<CR>もちろんオッケーなのです！！
records.en_original: You want to play with Rena and I...? That sounds wonderful!
records.en: You want to play with me and Rena-chan...?<CR>Of course, nanodesu!!

records.jp: あれ？　靭さん？　私オッケーって言ったっけ？<CR>靭さん？
records.en_original: Hm? Utsubo? I never agreed to this? Ustubo, are you listening to me?
records.en: Huh? Utsubo-san? Did I ever say I was okay with this?<CR>Utsubo-san?

records.jp: アソビタイ！　アソビタイ！
records.en_original: We want to play! We want to play!
records.en: We want to play! We want to play!

records.jp: ああもうわかった、遊ぶ、遊ぶから！
records.en: Fine, I get it! We'll play! We'll play!

records.jp: よし、二名確保完了。<CR>全員確保するまで気を抜くんじゃないぞ
records.en_original: All right, we've got two of them. We won't rest until we have them all.
records.en: All right, two secured.<CR>Don't let your guard down until we've got everyone.

records.jp: ――散ッ！
普通にしゃべるんかい
アソビタイ！
ひっ！？
わっ！？
アソビタイ！
え？
お？
アソビタイ！！
ひゃう！？
貴様らをここに集めたのは他でもない
records.en_original: The reason we've gathered you all here today...<CR>
records.en: The reason we've gathered you all here is simple.

records.jp: ――私たちと遊んでもらいます！！
records.en_original: Is to have a great time!

records.jp: 私たちと遊んでもらいます！！
records.en_original: You will all be playing with us!
records.en: You will all be playing with us!

records.jp: 鬼気迫る顔すぎない？
records.en_original: I can't think of anything worse.
records.en: Don't you look way too intense?

records.jp: そちらの要求は理解しました
records.en_original: I know that's what you want.

records.jp: でも私たちにもやりたいことはあるし
records.en_original: But we have our own things that we want to do.
records.en: But we have our own things that we want to do.

records.jp: 簡単に要求を呑むとはおもわないことだな！
records.en_original: Don't think we'll go along with you so easily!
records.en: Don't think we'll go along with you so easily!

records.jp: 皆さんいつの間に着替えたんですか？
records.en_original: When did you change into your swimsuits?
records.en: When did all of you change?

records.jp: まさか……あれは早着替え三銃士！？
records.en_original: Could it be... The Three Swimsketeers?!
records.en: Could those be... the Quick-Change Musketeers?!

records.jp: それはもういい
ええと、つまり情報を整理すると……
星崎さんたちが遊びたかったから私はここまで<CR>強制的に連れてこられたってことですね
records.en_original: You all want to play, so you've forced me here against my will.
records.en: So because Hoshizaki-san and the others wanted to play,<CR>I was forcibly dragged all the way here.

records.jp: うぐっ！
そんなことをせずとも、<CR>普通に声をかけて下されば良いのではと思いましたが
records.en_original: You could have just asked nicely, no need for all this.
records.en: I thought you could have simply asked me<CR>without going to all this trouble.

records.jp: うごっ！
きっとそういうことではないのですね……<CR>ともかく、はい、私も遊びに入れてください
records.en_original: Though maybe I'm wrong... Regardless, I'd be happy to spend time with you all.
records.en: I suppose that isn't the point...<CR>At any rate, yes. Please let me join you.

records.jp: がはっ！
正論と純粋って怖いわね
records.en: Sound logic and pure innocence are terrifying.

records.jp: 私たちが一番はしゃぐんだから
records.en_original: We're going to have even more fun than you all.
records.en: We're going to have the most fun!

records.jp: 途中で振り落とされないでよ
records.en_original: You better not push me in.
records.en: Don't get left behind along the way.

records.jp: お前ら、遊ぶぞーー！！
おーーー！！
あ～、楽しかった～
みんな観光名所も楽しんでくれたみたいだし、<CR>最高の一日だったよ～
records.en_original: I'm glad everyone seemed to enjoy all the stuff we built. Today was great.
records.en: It looks like everyone enjoyed the tourist attractions too.<CR>What a perfect day!

records.jp: プロジェクトΔ大成功なのです～
records.en_original: Project Delta was a huge success!
records.en: Project Delta was a huge success!

records.jp: 遊び疲れすぎでしょ
records.en: You're exhausted from playing way too hard.

records.jp: ……でも、本当に楽しかったな
聞きましたか、勇希さん？
聞こえましたとも。<CR>これは次のプロジェクト、簡単に可決がとれそうですな
records.en_original: But of course. I bet we'll get approval for our next project pretty easily.
records.en: I heard it loud and clear.<CR>Approval for our next project should be easy to secure.

records.jp: なのですなのです
……変なのもってきたら容赦なく却下だからね
records.en_original: I won't hesitate to deny any weird ideas you have.
records.en: I won't hesitate to deny any weird ideas you have.
